models.letter:
Dear user,

By the time you read this letter, our silent companion is already in place — no sign-up, no API key, and you never need to know where it lives. Just speak, and it will answer.

For this "works out of the box" ease we did some plodding homework: we put every model we could find on stage and tested them again and again — do they read code carefully, write reliably, and admit their mistakes honestly? The one that stayed is not the smartest of all, but after weighing everything, it is the most competent and the most worthy of the word "free". Its computing cost is on us; every conversation you have with it carries no burden.

And rest assured: everything in mdo lives on your own computer — sessions, memory, and files never leave your hands. We only hope it becomes a handy tool on your desk: ready when you need it, quiet when you don't.

If one day you outgrow it, you are welcome to bring your own model in "Models"; but before that, why not have a chat with this companion first.

— The mdo author
